parallels.note: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
translations.bsb: One night at Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream, and God said, “Ask, and I will give it to you!”
translations.kjv: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
translations.asv: In Gibeon Jehovah appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
